metadata.name: PaymentScheduleRequest
metadata.description: This API is used to add or delete a payment schedule in system for an account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values:0-9 Example:8000000000000037 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Example:4851455 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required.

request_fields.name: Frequency
request_fields.description: Frequency set with which payment will be made Possible values 0 = Monthly Specific Day 1 = Payment Due Date 2 = One Time 3 = Weekly 4 = Instant Pay 5 = Daily 6 = Bi-Weekly 7 = Semi-Monthly Condition:Mandatory When Request type = 0 NOTE: If 'Instant Pay' option is used for Payment then the balances will be updated at the same time but it can have different status based on the transaction processing through ACH.

request_fields.name: PaymentDate
request_fields.description: Date when payment is scheduled. Format: MM/DD/YYYY Example: 01/01/2020 Condition: If request type  = 0 and frequency = 2 then this is mandatory.

request_fields.name: PaymentType
request_fields.description: Type of Payment as below enumerations: 0 = Minimum Payment Due 1 = Statement Balance 2 = Current Balance 3 = Fixed Amount 4 = Adjusted Statement Balance Condition: Mandatory When Request type = 0

request_fields.name: MethodName
request_fields.description: Method Name uniquely identifies bank accounts in Core card system. Whenever user adds any bank account. This is required If User wants to send transaction in ACH. Condition: Mandatory When Request type = 0 and PaymentMode is 0(ACH).

request_fields.name: SpecificDay
request_fields.description: Specific day when scheduled payment should occur. If frequency = 0 Or frequency = 3 Or frequency = 6 then this is mandatory. Possible values: If (frequency = 0) 1-31 EOM If (frequency = 3 Or  frequency = 6) MON, TUE, WED, THU, FRI, SAT, SUN Condition : If frequency = 0 Or frequency = 3  Or frequency = 6 then this is mandatory if PaymentDate is not provided. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: EnterMemo
request_fields.description: Memo text entered by Customer service representative. Possible values: a-z,0-9 Example:abc Condition: Memo text required when deleting a schedule, if request type = 1 Allowable Values: 150

request_fields.name: ScheduleID
request_fields.description: Unique identifier for Schedule Payment. Condition:Mandatory When Request type = 1.

request_fields.name: RequestType
request_fields.description: Denotes type of action being attempted. Possible values: 0 = Add/Create Schedule 1 = Delete Schedule 2 = Update Example: 0

request_fields.name: Priority
request_fields.description: Denotes memo priority while deleting scheduled payment. Possible values: 0 = No, 1 = Yes Example:1 Condition: If request type = 1 then priority can be set.

request_fields.name: FixedAmount
request_fields.description: This is fixed value of payment to be used to schedule a payment. Condition: If payment type = 3 then this is mandatory

request_fields.name: PaymentMode
request_fields.description: If not provided then Default value - 0 (ACH) Possible values: 0 = ACH 1 = Debit Card With Token 2 = Debit Card With Card Number 3 = APC Payment

request_fields.name: Token
request_fields.description: Debit Card Token (Cardholder Authentication Verification Value(CAVV)) Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: CreateMethodForNextPayment
request_fields.description: If User wants to generate Method of Debit Card Token or Debit Card Number information for further Payments Possible values: 0 = No, 1 = Yes Example: 0 Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: XDaysBeforePaymentDueDate
request_fields.description: XdaysBeforePaymentDueDate will be enable, if Frequency is Payment Due Date. Possible Values: 0 - 28. If not provided then default values is 0 which means payment date will be Payment due Date.

request_fields.name: ApplicantType
request_fields.description: Selects the type of Applicant. Valid Values: 1,2,3 Example: 1 = Applicant, 2 = Co-Applicant, 3 = Cosigner

request_fields.name: UniqueId
request_fields.description: Unique ID is a transaction specific unique ID. This ID is unique for every transaction. If multiple calls are made by client for a specific transaction, the value of this tag will always be the same for a specific transaction. (GUID and UUID datatypes are supported for this tag). Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: F965C56F-C58F-EC11-B80E-A4BF010A357E Condition:For API user, if API Idempotency Applicable is set as Yes on CoreCredit, field is mandatory. The UniqueId is valid for 7 days from first submission of the request. Same request can be retried for 7 days without performing the same action twice.Idempotency will be checked at the belongingOwning Partner and Merchant Level. Allowable Values: 40

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: TransactionStatus
children.description: Shows status of transaction. Allowable Values: 20

children.name: ExternalErrorMessage
children.description: Error message, if any. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: DateOfPayment
children.description: Date when payment transaction will happen. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05
